reference.shortdesc: This section describes the HTTPS usage procedure by using the GET request process as an example.

section.title: SSL Certificate Selection & Authentication Level Configuration
section.msgblock: AT+MSSLCFG="cert",1,"s.ca" /*set SSL 1 to use the "s.ca" certificate */ OK AT+MSSLCFG="auth",1,1 /*set SSL 1 to use one-way authentication mode */ OK
section.note: SSL parameter configuration shall be completed before HTTP instance creation. Modification of SSL parameters during request processing is prohibited. Any parameter changes require prior request termination via AT+MHTTPTERM or AT+MHTTPDEL commands.

section.title: Instance Creation & Parameter Configuration
section.msgblock: AT+MHTTPCREATE="https://120.27.12.119:10443" +MHTTPCREATE: 0 OK AT+MHTTPCFG="ssl",0,1,1 /*Enable HTTPS and specify the use of SSL 1. */ OK
